cli.finalMessage:
Screen built at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:

- Mock order with 5 items (name, quantity, unit price, line total).
- Checkbox per item to select for return, with a reason `<select>` that enables once the item is checked.
- Live refund total and item count, with hints when items are unselected or missing a reason.
- Submit is disabled until every selected item has a reason; on submit it shows a confirmation state.
- Back link with an arrow icon (mirrors automatically in RTL via `:dir(rtl)`).
- Styling uses Strata's `--strata-*` CSS variables (with safe fallbacks, since `@strata/*` packages aren't installed in this sandbox to inspect exact component APIs) and logical CSS properties for RTL support.

One caveat: since `node_modules` isn't installed here, I couldn't run typecheck/dev server to verify — worth running `pnpm install && pnpm typecheck` once dependencies are available.
